entities.summary: A vast, unusually legible Roman port city where streets, apartments, baths, warehouses, temples, shops and a theatre form one coherent archaeological world.
entities.description: Ostia Antica is large enough to explore as a city rather than a sequence of isolated ruins. The strongest visit follows streets and neighbourhoods through domestic, commercial, religious and civic spaces, ideally with interpretation and enough time to wander beyond the headline theatre.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Urban scale, preservation and freedom to explore make this one of Europe’s most immersive archaeological destinations.

names.canonical: Stelvio Pass Road — Bormio to Prato

entities.summary: A 44.6 km SS38 crossing from Bormio over the 2,758 m Stelvio Pass to Prato allo Stelvio.
entities.description: From Bormio the SS38 climbs through the Braulio valley and tunnels to the pass; the South Tyrol side then descends through 48 tight bends toward Trafoi and Prato. The high road is seasonal and can close for snow, works or events, so live official road information remains essential.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Both sides are individually exceptional: the more enclosed Bormio approach contrasts with the exposed wall of switchbacks above Trafoi, producing a complete cross-pass journey rather than a one-sided climb.
